A unified platform to close the sim-to-real gap and de-risk robotics deployment

Unity provides robotics simulation software on a real-time 3D platform, enabling robotics developers and engineering teams to design, simulate, train, and validate systems before physical deployment. With Unity, teams drastically reduce deployment risks, deploy robotics systems faster, and scale their automation.

Accelerating robotics from simulation to deployment at scale

Unity Simulation Pro closes the sim-to-real gap for robotics by unifying robot simulation, XR teleoperation, 3D asset management, and on-device deployment into a single hardware-agnostic platform. Unity Simulation Pro is now available in early access.

Learn more about Simulation Pro

From model to physical hardware with real-time 3D simulation

Robotics developers and engineering teams import existing CAD and URDF (Unified Robot Description Format) models, simulate robots and their sensors in physically accurate environments, validate control and perception against edge cases, then deploy to physical hardware.

Ways teams put Unity to work

Virtual commissioning

Validate robot cells, control logic, and facility layouts against a high-fidelity twin before a machine is installed with Unity Industry.

SpiraTec cut commissioning time by 30%, validating live PLC and WMS software against a Unity Industry digital twin before the machine was built.

Sensor simulation & validation

Test LiDAR, camera, and depth perception against edge cases and real-world conditions before deployment with Simulation Pro.

TIER IV's AWSIM platform is developed with Unity Industry, simulating LiDAR under real-world conditions like rain and snow with VFX Graph, and replicating data feeds across eight-plus cameras in simulation, so validation happens off the roads

Synthetic data generation

Generate pre-labeled training datasets on demand, with full control over lighting, environment, and object placement with Unity Perception.

KITECH pulled bounding boxes, segmentation, and depth straight from Unity's simulation state, generating 100,000+ labeled human-robot frames.

Robot training & vizualization

Train and fine-tune robotic systems like manipulation and navigation through reinforcement learning in a simulation environment.

Seiko Epson built its RC+ 8.0 robot software on Unity, shipping real-time motion verification to its own customers

XR teleoperation

Operate, inspect, and monitor robots remotely with Unity XR. Unity’s XR capabilities power modern teleoperation frameworks with powerful authoring and features available out of the box.

Unity Simulation Pro

Unity Simulation Pro provides the core tooling for robotics simulation: URDF importer, out-of-the-box sensors, ROS integrations, and a Linux headless build target for parallelized, cloud-scale simulation workflows.

Unity Asset Manager

Seamlessly integrate the Unity Asset Manager into your organization’s workflows. Unity’s extensible and intuitive 3D asset management tool ensures quality across all your models and teams.

Learn more

Unity XR

Unity's industry-leading XR toolkit powers teleoperation, human-in-the-loop training, and Sim2Real pipelines. The toolkit handles teleoperation tasks, XR Hands captures fine-motor input for imitation learning, and OpenXR ensures broad headset compatibility.

Learn more

Unity ML-Agents

A PyTorch-based toolkit that turns Unity Industry scenes into AI training environments, providing a range of machine learning algorithms out of the box, and APIs for custom methods to plug in.

Unity ML-Agents

Unity Sentis

Bring pre-trained AI models directly into simulations for robot motion, object recognition, and pathfinding. Built on the ONNX standard, models run natively across all Unity-supported platforms, no cloud infrastructure required.

Accelerate your robotics deployment with Unity Industry Professional Training. Learn about best practices, reduce technical roadblocks, streamline onboarding, and reach your simulation goals faster.

Real-world robotics workflows in action

Validating autonomous driving

TIER IV built AWSIM, an open-source simulator powered by Unity Industry that runs eight-plus synchronized camera feeds and ray-traced LiDAR, moving Autoware validation off the road and into simulation.

Read case study

100,000 labeled frames direct from simulation

KITECH turned a metal casting plant into a Unity Industry digital twin from point cloud data with no CAD source, then generated 100,000+ pre-labeled human-robot frames straight from simulation state.

Read case study

Data-logging and playback for robotic surgery

Medtronic built a data-logging and playback pipeline in Unity Industry for a digital twin of its Hugo surgical robot, capturing 195 procedures across five sites to train new models and shape next-generation device design.

Read case study

Verifying robot motion before it ships

Seiko Epson rebuilt its RC+ robot simulator in Unity Industry, replacing a legacy OpenGL engine and growing its team from four to six engineers, to verify robot movements before deployment and end its reliance on a single specialized developer.

Frequently asked questions

Unity Simulation Pro is a robotics simulation authoring suite built on Unity’s real-time 3D platform. It enables robotics developers to build simulation environments, simulate sensors, train and validate robotic systems, and test workflows before physical deployment.

Unity Simulation Pro is a supported package that includes a URDF importer, out-of-the-box LiDAR, image, and IMU sensors, ROS 2 compatibility, and a headless Linux build target for parallelized simulation workflows. Documentation and onboarding resources are available to help teams get started.

Yes. Unity supports workflows that connect PLCs and automation systems to Unity-powered digital twins for virtual commissioning. SEW-EURODRIVE and SpiraTec have connected PLC controllers to Unity-based simulations to validate automation systems before physical deployment.

Yes. Unity tools can support synthetic data generation by giving developers control over environmental variables, lighting, object placement, and labels. KITECH used Unity simulation state to generate more than 100,000 pre-labeled human-robot frames, including bounding boxes, segmentation, and depth data.

Unity Simulation Pro is currently in Early Access. To get started, enroll your interest and a Unity account executive will contact your team. You can also explore the documentation for Unity XR capabilities, Unity ML-Agents package, and Unity Sentis to learn more about related robotics capabilities.

Unity has been powering robotics use cases across a wide range of domains. Some developers’ achievements in robotics include TIER IV’s AWSIM driving simulator, Medtronic robotic-assisted surgery system, Seiko Epson’s simulator for Industrial robot programming and KITECH’s digital twin for manufacturing.

A robotics learning pathway is available on Unity Academy for teams getting started. Explore the robotics learning pathway on Unity Academy.

Unity’s built-in Physics provides out-of-the-box support for stable articulated dynamics, continuous collision detection, colliders, triggers, layers, raycasts, and NavMesh.
